text:
maria_cs: Quick flag — EU dedicated pool experienced degraded throughput from ~09:10–09:45 UTC. Impacted 5 onboarding tenants (tenant IDs: T-1023, T-1098, T-1102, T-1115, T-1120). We're preparing outbound status and mitigation notes for them.

jenna_se: Thanks, Maria. Any immediate mitigation applied?

tom_support: Routed the affected onboarding traffic to the standby EU->US egress for most requests at 09:18 UTC, applied prefix KV cache warming for T-1023 and T-1098. Error spike came down by ~60% after routing.

liam_eng: Root cause preliminary: a memory leak in the batching worker on the pool nodes triggered continuous OOM cycles under a particular request shape. We pushed a temporary config to reduce concurrent batches (concurrency cap -> 8) and reclaimed nodes while we build a proper fix. Patch ETA ~3h.

maria_cs: Draft outbound to customers below — please review language, tone, and any legal/credit callouts. Need CS+Legal signoff before send.

maria_cs: ```Hi <CustomerTeam>,

We wanted to make you aware of a service disruption that affected onboarding to Redwood Dedicated in EU on Mar 25 between 09:10–09:45 UTC. During this window, some API requests for onboarding and ingestion experienced higher latency and intermittent 502s.

What we did: we routed traffic to a standby egress, applied cache warming for your tenant, and scaled replacement nodes to restore capacity. A code-level patch is in progress and expected to complete today.

Next steps: we will follow up with an RCA and corrective actions once validated. If this incident impacted your onboarding schedule or trial experience, we are offering a targeted service credit and a 30-minute remediation office hours session with an engineer next week to ensure your integration is fully healthy.

Would you like us to schedule the office hours and confirm a preferred time?

Regards,
Maria on behalf of Redwood Inference Customer Success
```

jenna_se: Draft looks good. Suggest we add a line with immediate workaround customers can try (e.g., reduce batch_size to 8 and pin to US pool) and include link to temporary runbook.

maria_cs: Good call — I'll add that. Proposed new line: "If you see elevated errors while we finalize the patch, temporarily set batch_size=8 or configure routing to the US pool via the console (Console > Deployments > Failover)." Thoughts?

liam_eng: Accurate. Also note that reducing max_tokens per call helped in our repro tests.

tom_support: Ops note: booking for office hours — I can host Tue/Wed 14:00–16:00 UTC. I'll include a short diagnostics checklist to run beforehand.

sara_ops: From billing/legal — proposed credit language: "A one-time credit equal to two days of estimated compute usage for impacted onboarding flows, applied to your next invoice." Need legal signoff before offering this to customers.

maria_cs: Ok, I'll loop in legal. @sara_ops please paste the final approved phrasing once confirmed.

ops_bot: Incident 2026-03-25-EU-Pool-Degradation created and linked to this thread — severity P2, incident lead: liam_eng.

maria_cs: Action items: 1) Legal to approve credit wording (sara_ops) 2) CS to send localized customer note once credits wording is approved (maria_cs) 3) Eng to push full patch and publish RCA (liam_eng) 4) Support to schedule office hours and share diagnostics checklist (tom_support).

tom_support: I'll draft calendar invites and diagnostics doc, will drop links here when ready.

jenna_se: For renewal-risk scoring — flag T-1102 and T-1115 as "high touch" for follow-up next week; they had longer ingestion retries.

maria_cs: Noted. I'll add a renewal-risk tag and prep a personalized outreach for those two.

liam_eng: ETA on final patch verification ~3h, will update thread with deployment window.

sara_ops: Legal ok with proposed credit wording as-is. You can offer the described credit to impacted tenants.

maria_cs: Great — sending the customer note now (localized EN/FR/DE). I'll paste the sent copy and recipients once done.

maria_cs: Sent to contacts on file for the 5 tenants. Recap: office hours invite pending, credits queued for billing. Will follow up with RCA in next 24–48h.

tom_support: Calendar invites created for Tue/Wed, diagnostics doc: https://internal.redwood/docs/rca-onboard-diagnostics (internal).

maria_cs: Closing loop here — cc'ing renewals team for high-touch follow-up. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
